infotexts.GUI.tooltips.timebetween: The interval of time between checking this option. Lower values mean a quicker bot reaction but is more performance-heavy
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.minimumcondition: Minimum condition of [item] before being considered empty
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.orderaction: Allow an AI that has [order] order to occasionally [action]
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.cleaningadditions: Some improvements to the "Deconstruct Items" and "Cleanup Items" orders
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.cleaningadditions.purchased: Set an automatic order to be added to any new crates received from merchants
Either deconstruct new crates or ignore them to prevent automatic cleanup
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.cleaningadditions.deconstru: When gathering items to deconstruct, the AI will also look for other items marked for deconstruction in the same stack/container and add said items to their inventory
Sets the maximum amount of additional items to check for (lower values may help with lag spikes)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.cleaningadditions.onlyusesh: If a ship has a deconstructor, the AI can ONLY use that in all circumstances
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.combattweaks: Various changes to player crew combat AI
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.combattweaks.preventattacki: AI will no longer attack anyone who's handcuffed or paralyzed. Helps with getting ransoms
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.combattweaks.arresthumansin: AI set to "Fight Intruders" will prioritize arresting hostile humans in the player sub, as long as they have a stun weapon and handcuffs
Should the AI only handcuff humans that have already been cuffed before (such as prisoners)
AI will switch back to generic offensive combat if their health goes below this percentage
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.combattweaks.prespinturrets: Allow the AI to spin-up turrents (such as a chaingun) before combat starts when set to the "Operate Weapons" order, allowing them to fire much faster
CLIENT-SIDE: Lowers the volume of the turret spin-up until it is almost muted (only when AI is pre-spinning)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.crewstaysinsub: Bots (and you) will spawn in the sub when docking at any outpost
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.equipitems: Settings that deal with bot AI equipment
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.equipitems.crewloadout: Set items that the AI should try to seek out; specifying by inventory slot and by job
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.equipitems.crewloadouttitle: Click the inventory slots below to highlight them, then click an item to assign it to that slot (NOTE: Larger items, like HMGs, may require more than 1 slot selected!). Right click to specify minimum quality and choose tags by right clicking in the item picking GUI. Use the arrows to cycle between jobs, including mod-added
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.equipitems.timebetween: Increases the delay between AI attempting to equip armor. Lower=faster, but it really doesn't need to be low at all
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.equipitems.reequiparmor: AI will attempt to equip any armor inside their inventory every so often. This helps solve the issue of AI sometimes "forgetting" to put a helmet back on after using a diving mask, for example
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.ladderfix: Bots will periodically "unstick" themselves from ladders if they get stuck
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.mutesingleplayerbotconversa: CLIENT-SIDE: The same setting as "Disable bot conversations" for servers (muting random bot conversations) but works for singleplayer
Completely disables all bot-created chat messages (again, in singleplayer only)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.operatereactortweaks: Adjust some behavior with the "Operate Reactor" order
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.operatereactortweaks.behavi: Change the behavior related to actually operating the reactor, optionally only allowing refuelling if a reactor control circuit is detected or just permanently
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.operatereactortweaks.numfue: How many fuel rods the reactor should have
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.orders: CLIENT-SIDE: Add custom orders to the middle-mouse order menu
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory: AI will refill some of their empty reloadables while idling/waiting
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.onlyatfr: AI will only replenish when docked at an outpost
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.orderact: leave their post to refill their inventory
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.fillempt: Allow bots to determine "empty" containers (guns without ammo, welding tools without fuel, etc.) and determine what needs to fill it
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.forcesam: Only replace items with the same exact item type (regular Battery Cells will NOT replace Fulgurium Batter Cells, for example)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.replenishinventory.forcequa: The replacement item must be of equal or greater quality than the existing item
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterloaditems: AI set to the "Load Items" order these items will bring full ones to the empty tool/container first, replacing them in the slot, rather than just emptying the partially depleted ones and leaving your artifact case without a battery
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterloaditems.option: Apply this setting to AI loading [item]
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterpets: Various changes to the pet AI and related human bot AI
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterpets.eatfoodininvent: Pets will eat food items that are inside of their own inventory
Pets normally refuse to eat when their owner is nearby. This disables that for food in the pet's inventory
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterpets.botsplaywhenidl: Lets the human AI play with nearby, visible, and sad pets
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.smarterpets.cleanableproduc: Pet produce can now be cleaned up (specifically, poop, chitin chunks, and mucus balls). They will be placed in the same type of containers as pomegrenades
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usefurniture: Various tweaks to let the AI use some furniture
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usefurniture.autousewhenidl: Specify furniture to use when idle(NOTE: Disabling reverts to vanilla behavior, which is only chairs)
Bots will use [furniture] when they idle
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usefurniture.stayinbedifhur: If a bot is sleeping in a bed, the bot is injured, and the bed is in a safe location, then they will remain in the bed until healed
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents: Lets the AI utilize some talents that they previously couldn't
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.stopafterbuffed: Bots will only play music when an unbuffed crewmate is within sight/range, instead of all the time when idling
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.assistant.jengam: AI Assistants with the "Jenga Master" talent will go around the ship and apply the Max Stack Size bonus to any applicable containers when idling
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.assistant.nonthr: AI Assistants with the "Non-Threatening" talent will ragdoll if they're attacked, their health goes below a certain percentage, and the room they're in isn't on fire or flooding and they don't have a diving suit/mask
How low the bot's health should get before ragdolling
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.assistant.inspir: AI Assistants with the "Inspiring Tunes" talent will play instruments in their inventory periodically. NOTE: All instruments (NOT just the bikehorn) work with this talent (even in vanilla!)
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.captain.steadytu: AI Captains will now play the harmonica when idling, providing psychosis resistance
infotexts.GUI.tooltips.usetalents.engineer.melodic: AI Engineers will play guitar, providing a 25% increase in repair speed
